string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: Online subtitles work again: the OpenSubtitles search failed for every title with more than one word (“Couldn’t search for subtitles”)
Subtitles are searched for the right movie: first by the movie or show ID, then by name and year, then by name only
Movies whose automatic subtitle failed will try again
Audio: the player’s ▼ switches to the movie’s dubbed or subtitled version at the same spot
Trailer: BACK closes YouTube and returns to the details page; when the trailer ends, the page comes back by itself
Trailer: the movie catalog’s trailer comes before the list’s (which is sometimes for another movie), and more link formats open

Choice lists (audio, subtitles, seasons, quality and the rest) now look like the home screen: a panel on the right that keeps the movie visible, the chosen line large with the orange dot, and “3 of 14”
Online subtitles show the release name in readable form, the language by name, downloads in thousands and “made for this file” when it matches
Trailer: a notice on screen no longer closes YouTube by mistake
